mapper.select: SELECT venue_id AS venueId, venue_name AS venueName FROM VENUE ORDER BY venue_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PERFORMANCES (p_title, venue_id, category_id, poster_url, ins_id, ins_ip) VALUES (#{pTitle}, #{venueId}, #{categoryId}, #{posterUrl}, #{insId}, #{insIp})
INSERT INTO PERFORMANCE_ROUND (performance_id, round_time, open_time, round_status, ins_id, ins_ip) VALUES (#{performanceId}, #{roundTime}, #{openTime}, 'OPEN', #{insId}, #{insIp})
mapper.select:
SELECT A.performance_id, A.venue_id, A.category_id, C.category_nm, A.p_title, V.venue_name, A.poster_url, A.created_per, B.round_id, B.round_time, B.open_time, B.round_status FROM PERFORMANCES A LEFT OUTER JOIN VENUE V ON A.venue_id = V.venue_id LEFT OUTER JOIN CATEGORIES C ON A.category_id = C.category_id LEFT OUTER JOIN PERFORMANCE_ROUND B ON A.performance_id = B.performance_id
AND A.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND (A.p_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR V.venue_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY A.created_per DESC

SELECT A.performance_id, A.venue_id, A.p_title, V.venue_name, A.poster_url, A.created_per, B.round_id, B.round_time, B.open_time, B.round_status FROM PERFORMANCES A LEFT OUTER JOIN VENUE V ON A.venue_id = V.venue_id LEFT OUTER JOIN PERFORMANCE_ROUND B ON A.performance_id = B.performance_id WHERE A.performance_id = #{performanceId} ORDER BY B.round_time

SELECT cast_id AS castId, performance_id AS performanceId, round_id AS roundId, actor_nm AS actorName, casting_nm AS castingNm, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM PERFORMANCE_CAST WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId} ORDER BY sort_order, cast_id

SELECT round_id AS roundId, performance_id AS performanceId, round_time AS roundTime, open_time AS openTime, round_status AS roundStatus FROM PERFORMANCE_ROUND WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId} AND DATE_FORMAT(round_time, '%Y-%m') = #{month} ORDER BY round_time

SELECT A.performance_id, A.venue_id, A.category_id, C.category_nm, A.p_title, V.venue_name, A.poster_url, A.created_per, B.round_id, B.round_time, B.open_time, B.round_status FROM ( SELECT P.performance_id, P.venue_id, P.category_id, P.p_title, P.poster_url, P.created_per FROM PERFORMANCES P LEFT OUTER JOIN VENUE V ON P.venue_id = V.venue_id
AND P.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND (P.p_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR V.venue_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY P.created_per DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} ) A LEFT OUTER JOIN VENUE V ON A.venue_id = V.venue_id LEFT OUTER JOIN CATEGORIES C ON A.category_id = C.category_id LEFT OUTER JOIN PERFORMANCE_ROUND B ON A.performance_id = B.performance_id ORDER BY A.created_per DESC, B.round_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM PERFORMANCE_ROUND WHERE performance_id = #{performanceId} AND open_time <= NOW()
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM PERFORMANCE_ROUND WHERE round_id = #{roundId} AND open_time <= NOW()
